items.html: For now, in this second time, it was not enough that the inner NHY of AA himself were included in his HGT, in the manner that they were above in the one Ibur of the externality; rather, his HGT also ascended and were included in his own HBD. Thus it is found that the nine Sefirot of AA were included and became in the aspect of three within three, and from this coupling the Ibur was made in nine months, corresponding to the number of the nine Sefirot of AA. Then the inner VAK of ZON were also made, and from their interiority all the souls are drawn, as stated above.
